title: Aravind Sametha Veera Raghava
desc: A young man sets out to avenge his father's death but soon realises that violence is not the key to his salvation. His life changes when he meets another man, who helps him rediscover himself.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Annapoorani: The Goddess of Food
desc: Annapoorani, a girl born into an orthodox Hindu family, aspires to become a top chef. However, she faces obstacles that include prejudice and conventional beliefs.

title: Jigarwala No. 1
desc: A doctor living abroad returns to India to sell his property, where he falls in love.

title: Baaghi 4
desc: Following a failed suicide attempt, a man struggles with reality and descends into turmoil. His family faces uncertainty while a concealed truth lures him into a complex maze of obsession and love.

title: Singh Is Kinng
desc: Happy, notoriously famous for his antics, is sent to fetch Lakhan so that he can meet his ailing father. But, in Australia, Happy ends up taking Lakhan's place as the king of the local underworld.

title: Rashtra Kavach Om
desc: A classified mission leaves a para commando with amnesia, unanswered questions and the duty of protecting his nation from terrorists. Along the way, he must find his father and prove his innocence.

title: Popcorn
desc: Two strangers with pent-up issues meet inside a mall elevator that gets stuck for 18 hours, where their hostility towards each other causes friction.

title: Raanjhanaa
desc: A carefree youngster sacrifices his love after his childhood sweetheart plans to marry a man from her own community. Nevertheless, fate convinces him to pursue his lady love at any cost.

title: Jawaan
desc: Azad fights against the systemic oppression of society. Soon, he finds himself in a web of deceit and crime as he teams up with a group of allies to take down a ruthless arms dealer.

title: Holiday: A Soldier Is Never off Duty
desc: An army intelligence officer arrives in Mumbai to spend the holiday with his family. However, he must switch back to work mode after a bomb rips through the heart of the city.

title: Spyder
desc: Shiva, an intelligence officer, develops a phone software that helps him track those in need of help. He sets out to save the people of Hyderabad when he realises that a serial killer is on the loose.

title: Kantara: A Legend - Chapter 1
desc: In pre-colonial Karnataka, during the Kadamba dynasty era, the ritual of Bhuta Kola takes root in the culture. Meanwhile, the seeds for the rise of Kaadubettu Shiva are also sown.

title: Uri: The Surgical Strike
desc: Major Vihaan Singh Shergill of the Indian Army leads a covert operation against a group of militants who attacked a base in Uri, Kashmir, in 2016 and killed many soldiers.
